chunks: Muhammad ibn Ahmad al-Qummi, from his uncle Abdullah ibn al-Salt, from Yunus ibn Abd al-Rahman, from Abdullah ibn Sinan, from Husayn al-Jamal, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him)

Regarding the Statement of Allah, Blessed and Exalted: 'Our Lord, show us those who led us astray from among the jinn and the men, that we may place them under our feet so that they may be of the lowest,' he said: 'Those two.' Then he said: 'And that one was a Satan.'
ai.seo_question: Who are the two people mentioned in Surah Fussilat verse 29 according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In this hadith from *Al-Kafi*, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) provides a specific exegetical interpretation of Quran 41:29, identifying the 'two' who misled humanity as the first Caliphs, Abu Bakr and Umar. He further characterizes Umar specifically as a 'shaytan' (misleader), offering a foundational Shia perspective on the political and spiritual consequences of the early succession. This narration underscores the Shia view of the Caliphs not merely as political successors but as active agents of deviation from the Prophet's true path.
